summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs, so _RDFNamespace inherits it. The IPython completion hook now lists dir(str(self.uri)). Added three tests covering prefix, RDFS closed, and RDF closed membership, including negatives. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so the tests are unverified.
